# openobserve_folder (Data Source)

Reads a folder, looked up either by `folder_id` or by `name`. Useful for placing dashboards and alerts into folders that already exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Place a dashboard into a folder that already exists, without importing it.
data "openobserve_folder" "shared" {
  name = "Shared"
}

resource "openobserve_dashboard" "example" {
  folder_id      = data.openobserve_folder.shared.folder_id
  dashboard_json = file("${path.module}/dashboard.json")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `folder_id` (String) Folder identifier. Supply this or `name`.
- `folder_type` (String) What the folder holds: `dashboards` (default), `alerts`, `reports`, or `synthetics`.
- `name` (String) Folder name. Supply this or `folder_id`.
- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Folder description.
- `id` (String) Data source ID in the format `{org_id}/{folder_type}/{folder_id}`.
